coordinate_frame.reference_x: local ENU East (m), per-sequence origin at row 0

velocity_decomposition.note: navigation convention; verified below vs d(reference_x,y)/dt

heading_propagation_decision: CONSTANT heading (psi_dot = 0) + heading process noise. Rationale: gyro_z shows |corr| = 0.006 with true yaw rate across the 4 test sequences (all < 0.3) - the phone gyro carries no usable vehicle yaw-rate signal, so integrating it would inject noise. No other rotation sensor is trustworthy (Android fused ORIENTATION yaw is also ~0 corr per project EDA; magnetometer is corrupted by the vehicle). Heading error is absorbed by Q_psi and is the motivation for Step 15 (NHC).
gnss_measurement_source: reference_x / reference_y (vehicle GNSS/INS ENU fix), used ONLY where gnss_available==1 AND the sample is outside the simulated outage. Phone latitude/longitude updates only every ~9 s (1% of samples) so it is unusable for 10 Hz updates. Consistent with the Step 13C convention (13C used reference_x/y as truth and pre-outage init).
